notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
